title: Hidden Commitment: When Language Models Silently Pick a Side and How Steering Can Surface It
summary: In held-out conflicting-document rows, steering the Qwen source-choice direction shifts which document supplies the answer; Gemma provides a weaker transfer check. The intervention test uses 100 held-out question IDs in original/swapped order (200 rows), with random-direction controls; small-model, controlled-conflict scope.
ai_technology: Qwen3.5-0.8B and Gemma 3 1B supply learned residual states; readouts and controlled steering test how internal activations select between conflicting documents
